_description: The four lifecycle events that define a scoped prerequisite. Progression: promoted → reaffirmed (3-way convergence) → weakened (housing-006 bypass). The weakened event carries the scope rule: new_scope + equivalent_safety_conditions. No event is modified — all coexist in federation.jsonl.

events._note: Promoted when housing-001 and housing-002 independently discovered the condition.
Reaffirmed when housing-004 (community kitchen) independently converged on the same condition.
Weakened when housing-006 (pre-certified modular kitchen) bypassed via equivalent safety path. Scope narrowed to non_precertified_spaces. The prerequisite was NOT abolished.

_design_note: scope_rules are derived from the weakened event's equivalent_safety_conditions. No hardcoded scope tables. The resolver reads the event directly.
